request.initial_prompt: Leontes. Make that thy question, and go rot! Dost think I am so muddy, so unsettled, To appoint myself in this vexation; sully The purity and whiteness of my sheets, (Which to preserve is sleep, which being spotted Is goads, thorns, nettles, tails of wasps) Give scandal to the blood o' th' prince, my son, (Who I do think is mine, and love as mine) Without ripe moving to't? Would I do this? Could man so blench?
request.hotwords: Leontes, Make, Dost, I, Give, Who, Without, Would, Could

raw_segments.text: Leontes, Make that thy question, and go rot! Dost think I am so muddy, so unsettled, To appoint myself in this vexation, sully The purity and whiteness of my sheets, Which to preserve is sleep, which being spotted Is goads, thorns, nettles, tails of wasps, Give scandal to the blood o' th' prince, my son, Who I do think is mine, and love as mine Without ripe moving to't? Would I do this? Could man so blench?
